author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 

GO:0030205 dermatan sulfate metabolic process  [2 direct EXP]
GO:0030208 dermatan sulfate biosynthetic process  [4 direct EXP]
GO:0050652 dermatan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthetic process, chain elongation (0 direct EXP)
GO:0120541 dermatan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthetic process, enzymatic modification (0 direct EXP)
GO:0030204 chondroitin sulfate metabolic process [9 direct EXP]
GO:0030206 chondroitin sulfate biosynthetic process [43 direct EXP]
GO:0050653 chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan biosynthetic process, chain elongation (3 direct EXP)
GO:0120540 chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan biosynthetic process, enzymatic modification (0 direct EXP)
GO:0015014 heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthetic process, chain elongation
GO:0015015 heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthetic process, enzymatic modification

The reason for obsoletion is that these glycosaminoglycans are not synthesized in other contexts than in proteoglycans, so the sets of merged terms are redundant. 

Annotations are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MzApBi8oFxzcBNm0FXA-j8KvkQkuplkJ6cVT_lDtlcY/edit?gid=0#gid=0


See [#28977](https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/28977)
title: Review annotations to redundant glycosaminoglycan metabolic process terms

author: pgaudet
body:
There are 148 manual annotations: 
BHF-UCL	2 - done
ComplexPortal	1
FlyBase	16 - done
MGI	49
MTBBASE	1
Reactome	30
RGD	1
UniProt	34
WB	12
ZFIN	2

If you agree with the proposed replacements and your group has an automatic replacement system, no action is needed. 

There are 3 Reactome mappings and 1 InterPro mapping.
